Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: orthographic back-view albedo texture source for an existing 3D game decoration, Mid hive spire.
Edit target: INPUT IMAGE 1, guide_back.png, the plain grey 1024 x 1024 model render. This image is the absolute authority for geometry, silhouette, all internal shape edges and openings, camera, framing and placement. Paint ONLY this exact existing shape.
Supporting references: INPUT IMAGE 2, design_reference.png, is the approved HD authority for design, colours and materials only; INPUT IMAGE 3, concept_crop.png, is the original concept. Do not import the reference's three-quarter camera, wider silhouette, additional geometry or lighting.

Return exactly one 1024 x 1024 RGBA image with a genuinely transparent background, at the guide's original resolution and framing. Preserve the guide alpha silhouette pixel-for-pixel, including its existing holes and spaces: object bounds x=303..720 and y=66..957 on the 1024 square. Keep every thorn tip, polygonal outer contour, notch, root, opening, ridge and shape edge in exactly the guide's location. Keep the tall narrow back view with its asymmetry, upright ivory top spike and splayed root base. Do not smooth away the shape edges, change the pose, resize, shift, rotate, crop, reframe, add spikes or create new openings.

Paint the guide's surfaces with the approved design's glossy wet black-violet resin and chitin, glowing orange slit windows and ivory bone thorns. Organic resin ribs are deep black-violet and plum; thorns and apex are warm pale ivory bone with restrained fine natural grain; the existing recessed window/sac forms have saturated orange and amber glowing colours and fine organic membranes. Retain the exact shapes and positions shown in the guide. Material character comes from local colour and fine surface texture, not reflections or lighting.

LIGHTING IS CRITICAL: this is ALBEDO for texture projection, not a beauty render. Flat, even, shadowless frontal light. No cast shadows, ambient-occlusion darkening, strong specular highlights, reflections, rim lights, bloom, glow halos, gradients from directional illumination, background or floor. Paint glowing sacs and seams at their glowing orange colour; they must not cast orange light onto surrounding resin or bone. Every surface remains evenly readable.
No text, labels, border, watermark or additional objects. Only the painted exact guide on transparency.

CORRECTIVE REGENERATION — exact 1024 x 1024 image edit for texture projection.
Use case: style-transfer. Edit INPUT 1 (guide_back.png) directly as the fixed pixel canvas. OUTPUT MUST BE EXACTLY 1024 PIXELS WIDE AND 1024 PIXELS HIGH, the same dimensions as input 1, without reframing, scaling or cropping. The result will be used raw and cannot be resized.

INPUT 1 is the plain grey back-view model, the sole geometry and alpha authority. INPUT 2 (design_reference.png) supplies only surface colours and material identity. INPUT 3 (concept_crop.png) supplies the original material concept.
Recolour the existing grey guide surfaces. Copy its outer silhouette, internal boundaries, voids, jagged polygonal contours and alpha coverage exactly. All positions remain unchanged, including the long ivory apex at (532,66), the leftward base tip at (303,946), the rightward base tip at (720,941), and the lowest base edge at y=957. The whole narrow object remains inside x=303..720, y=66..957. Every existing spike, root and inset membrane shape must stay precisely aligned to the grey guide. No added spikes, added holes, extra window shapes, smoothed contours or geometry from the three-quarter reference. No isolated pixels, glow, fringe or dust outside the guide alpha mask. Preserve its existing internal transparent spaces.

Apply the design's base-colour materials: very dark black-violet and muted plum resin/chitin ribs, warm ivory bone on existing thorns and the top spike, orange/amber window membranes in the guide's existing inset sac/slit shapes. Fine subtle organic grain only. The wet glossy resin is represented by its base colour; gloss and illumination will be computed by the game later.

THIS IS A FLAT UNLIT ALBEDO PASS. Uniform shadowless illumination straight from the viewer. Remove all baked shadows, occlusion shading, specular glints, glossy white streaks, bright reflections and rim highlights. No bright lines tracing every rib. Do not shade the faceted guide with a directional light. Orange windows are solid luminous-colour material with modest membrane colour detail; no bright light cores, bloom or orange spill onto the shell. Ivory is evenly cream coloured, not shiny gold. No lighting gradient across the model.
Background must be truly alpha-transparent, with clean guide-aligned edges and no floor or backdrop. No text, no labels. Deliver one original-resolution 1024x1024 transparent PNG; retain the input guide's exact silhouette and framing.
